name: Frostweed
caution: Used as a mild folk tea; a bitter herb best taken occasionally rather than in quantity. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Tall winged stems and white fall flowers; on the first hard freeze the stems split and extrude curls of ice, the 'frost' that names it.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: The dried leaves make a mild traditional tea; the plant is grown as much for its ribbon-ice spectacle and its butterflies.
